name: Popover
description: A click-triggered floating panel with a pointing arrow that scales in from the trigger. Placement is measured against the viewport: it honours side and align, flips to the opposite side when there is no room and keeps the arrow pointed at the trigger.
a11yNotes: The trigger is a button with aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded and aria-controls. The panel is a non-modal role="dialog" labelled by its heading and described by its description. Focus moves to the first field on open; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger, as does the labelled Close button. Pressing outside or tabbing out of the panel closes it. All inputs have associated labels. The arrow is aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the panel only fades.

defaultProps.title: Dimensions
defaultProps.description: Set the dimensions for the layer.

propsApi.name: onOpenChange
propsApi.description: Called whenever the popover requests to open or close.

propsApi.name: side
propsApi.description: Preferred side of the trigger; flips to the opposite side when it does not fit.

propsApi.name: align
propsApi.description: Alignment along the trigger edge; the panel is clamped inside the viewport.

propsApi.name: sideOffset
propsApi.description: Gap between trigger and panel in pixels.

propsApi.name: showArrow
propsApi.description: Show the arrow pointing at the trigger.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Panel heading, used as the accessible name.

propsApi.name: description
propsApi.description: Supporting text under the heading, used as the accessible description.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Panel content; defaults to four labelled dimension inputs.

propsApi.name: width
propsApi.description: Panel width in pixels (capped to the viewport).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Focus ring color of the inputs.

propsApi.name: closeOnOutsideClick
propsApi.description: Close when pressing outside the trigger and panel.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
